Title: Jan Bas & Band + CANINI
Description:
Jan Bas blends heartland Americana, soul and roots into warm, soulful songs brimming with timeless rock ’n’ roll romance.

Jan Bas: songwriter, guitarist and rock ’n’ roll romantic with his eyes on the horizon and his heart in the right place. With his feet firmly planted in heartland Americana, soul and roots, he is building his own, lived-in sound, somewhere between Richard Hawley, Leon Bridges and the young Bruce Springsteen. His long-awaited debut album is due out in April 2027, but this is no true debutant. Jan Bas creates songs that have been given time to mature, and you can hear that in every note: warm, honest and straight from the musician’s heart. He will be presenting his debut album at AB Brussels.

CANINI is a new trio centred around guitarist and songwriter Fabio Canini (Sloper, The Scabs, Along Comes Mary). Known as a loud rock guitarist, Canini has deliberately chosen a different approach here: the classical guitar as a starting point for songs that breathe, move and leave room for interpretation.

Title: Keo
Description: The British quartet Keo , centred around brothers Finn and Conor Keogh, have built up a formidable live reputation over the past few years at DIY gigs that are often bursting with energy. On their debut album Put A Smile On For Me, they continue in the same vein with a mix of Pearl Jam-style grunge, 90s alternative rock and contemporary British guitar music in the vein of Fontaines D.C. Kerrang! awarded the album 5/5 and described it as “a giant leap for bandkind”, whilst Rolling Stone highlights Keo as one of the most interesting new guitar bands of their generation.

Title: RIP Magic
Description: RIP Magic is a breath of fresh air from London. The four-piece led by Marco Pini (who also plays with Sorry) moves somewhere between post-punk, electronica and hip-hop. Even before they released their first music, the band had already caught the attention of Tyler, The Creator and were described by The Guardian as ‘London’s buzziest band’. Since then, they have supported acts including LCD Soundsystem and Fcukers. James Murphy (LCD Soundsystem) produced their single ‘5words’. Their debut album, 1,2,3, was released at the end of October 2026, with Clash Magazine, amongst others, writing: “A restless, brilliantly playful debut that rarely stays in one place for long.” ﻿

Title: Ministry + Die Krupps
Description:
The definitive end of an era: Al Jourgensen is calling it a day for good. The legendary industrial pioneer has announced Ministry ’s very last tour.

For Jourgensen, full circle has been achieved. From the early new wave and synthpop of ‘With Sympathy’ (1983) to the heavy-hitting ‘Twitch’ (1986), the genre-defining ‘The Land Of Rape And Honey’ (1988) and the successful ‘Psalm 69’ (1992): Ministry changed the musical landscape forever. With this farewell tour, the band is bringing a career spanning more than forty years to a close. The tour follows the release of their very last album, ‘Hate To Go (Take Out Or Delivery)’, due out this autumn. The record promises to be a razor-sharp farewell, including the return of Paul Barker. The single “Burned Out” offers a first taste of the album and is an instant hit. Although Jourgensen vents his frustration in his lyrics that, in forty years, hardly anything has changed politically or socially, the concert at Ancienne Belgique promises to be an energetic finale. Together with his live band, Ministry will go down fighting. Expect an intense setlist in which new material blends seamlessly with the classics that laid the foundations for industrial metal.

This is the very last chance for Belgian fans to bid farewell to one of the most influential bands in the history of the genre.

Title: Mastodon + Monolord
Description:
GRAMMY Award-winning band Mastodon have steadily evolved into one of the most influential, inimitable, andiconic rock bands of the modern era. Since emerging in 2000, the Atlanta band has defied both sonic and thematicboundaries with an uncategorizable, undeniable, and uncompromising vision unlike anything else in music.

This vision manifested over the course of canonical albums such asLeviathan, which landed on Rolling Stone's coveted The 100 Greatest Metal Albums of All Time. Following the seminal Crack The Skye [named one of the best albums of 2009 by Time], they earned three consecutive Top 10 debuts on the Billboard Top 200 withThe Hunter [2011] ,Once More 'Round the Sun [2014], and Emperor of Sand[2017]. Out of six career nominations, they received a GRAMMYAward in the category of "Best Metal Performance" for "Sultan's Curse."

They are the rare creative force whose musiccan be felt everywhere from Game of Thrones, Adult Swim, The History Channel, and DC comics films to Coachellaand Bonnaroo. The group reached another critical high watermark via their ninth full-length,Hushed and Grim.Featuring the GRAMMY Award-nominated "Pushing The Tides," it marked the band's third straight #1 bow on theBillboard Hard Rock Albums Chart.

Title: Bai Kamara Jr
Description:
A much-loved figure on the Brussels music scene, Bai Kamara Jr. is also an internationally recognised artist, celebrated for his distinctive voice, personal songwriting, and soulful blend of afro-blues, soul and rock. The Sierra Leonean singer-songwriter has opened for artists such as Vaya Con Dios, Vanessa Paradis and Keb’ Mo’, shared stages with Habib Koité, Cassandra Wilson and Rokia Traoré, and collaborated with Youssou N’Dour.

In 2019, he formed Bai Kamara Jr & The Voodoo Sniffers . Their albums Salone (2020) and Traveling Medicine Man (2023) earned international acclaim and widespread radio airplay, with Salone receiving a Blues Blast Music Award nomination in the US.

His new solo album, Future Street , arrives on 26 March 2027 via MIG Music. To mark its release, Bai presents a special show built around his voice, electric guitar and stompbox. A stripped-back, deeply personal encounter with an artist who continues to reinvent himself while staying true to his roots. Some guests might join this exclusive show but be prepared for a very warm and cosy afro-blues evening.

Title: Charles
Description: With her red hair and intense, powerful voice, CHARLES is instantly recognizable. With Sabotage, her double EP released in March, the young Belgian artist is back with a more pop sound than ever and now offers her songs in two versions: English and French. She took festivals by storm this summer and plans to confirms her momentum with this performance. Don't miss her!

Title: Anthrax + Kerry King, Sacred Reich
Description:
Caught in a Mosh! On Friday 9 April, thrash metal icons Anthrax are coming to the Ancienne Belgique in Brussels. The New York thrashers will be there to present their brand-new album Cursum Perficio, their first studio album in ten years.

Anthrax were formed in Queens in 1981 and, alongside Metallica, Slayer and Megadeth, went on to become one of the ‘Big Four’ of American thrash metal. The 1980s saw the release of albums such as Spreading the Disease and Among the Living, featuring tracks like ‘Madhouse’, ‘Caught in a Mosh’ and ‘Indians’. With Persistence of Time, the band continued that momentum in the early 1990s. Anthrax soon began to look beyond the boundaries of thrash metal. In 1991, the band collaborated with Public Enemy on ‘Bring the Noise’, a collaboration that introduced both genres to a new audience. Even after that, Anthrax continued to seek out new influences, without abandoning their recognisable style. In 2026, ‘Cursum Perficio’ will be released, the first new Anthrax album since 2016’s ‘For All Kings’.

The special guest that evening is Slayer guitarist Kerry King . Following Slayer’s break-up, King went on to form his own band, alongside Paul Bostaph (Slayer), Phil Demmel (ex-Machine Head), Mark Osegueda (Death Angel) and Kyle Sanders (Hellyeah). In 2024, the band released their debut album, From Hell I Rise. Sacred Reich will be the support act.

Title: Stand High Patrol + Elisethere
Description:
The story of Stand High Patrol begins in 2000 in Brittany (France) when two guys decide to create their own sound system sharing their common passion for reggae & dub. Rootystep (selecta) and MacGyver (operator) begin to collect records and purchase music equipment. They are quickly joined by Pupajim who becomes the MC, the singer and the dub builder of the crew. After 26 years Stand High has created a true musical identity and has established itself as one of the essential sound systems of the French dub scene.

The identity of Stand High Patrol comes from the unique voice of Pupajim and the singular style of his dub. This style, named Dubadub is defined as a subtle blend of dub, reggae, hip hop, new wave, house and trip hop. In 2009, the crew creates his own label Stand High Records . In 2012, after releasing several ep's, the Dubadub Muskateerz present their debut album Midnight Walkers followed by 5 albums, the latest being the double LP Skanking & Jacking where they continue to defy boundaries with a new Dub / House experience that carves out and maps a entirely own sonic landscape. But it's from the stage you perceive the right energy from their legendary live shows of which you wish they would never end.

Warm up is in the hands of Elisethere . This DJ - originally from Toulouse and currently residing in Brussels - is recognized for her selecta style, which often features a dub siren.

Title: Ninajirachi
Description:
After Ninajirachi made a big impression during her performance at Pukkelpop in August, she is returning. In just a few years, the Australian has established herself as one of the most creative artists on the international electronic music scene. She broke through in 2017 with the single “Pure Luck” and creates a unique universe where hyperpop, club music and futuristic electro converge. A style all of her own that is as daring as it is accessible. From her first EPs ‘Lapland’ and ‘Blumiere’ to the projects ‘Second Nature’, ‘4x4’ and ‘girl edm’, she continues to push her own boundaries. As an acclaimed producer, she has collaborated with Ableton on the launch of “Ableton Live 11”, for which she created the official showcase project for the software.

In 2025, she reached a new milestone with ‘I Love My Computer’, her debut album. Featuring tracks such as “All I Am”, “iPod Touch” and “Fuck My Computer”, the album immediately reached number one in the ARIA Dance Albums Chart. The album was acclaimed by critics and received rave reviews from Pitchfork, Billboard and Dazed. It earned her eight nominations for the ARIA Awards, of which she won three, as well as the 2025 Australian Music Prize in the Album of the Year category. This recognition was accompanied by a spectacular international rise, from Coachella to Lollapalooza and a appearance at Pukkelpop, right through to sold-out concerts worldwide.

Title: Rodrigo y Gabriela
Description:
The legendary Mexican duo Rodrigo y Gabriela returns to Belgium with a brand-new international tour: the “OurHome Tour.” On April 13, 2027, the two guitar virtuosos will stop in Brussels for a concert that promises to be as intense as it is enchanting. For their Belgian fans, this is the perfect opportunity to experience “Our Home,” their ninth and most recent album, live.

For more than two decades, Rodrigo Sánchez and Gabriela Quintero have been pushing the boundaries of the acoustic guitar with their unique and instantly recognizable sound. After leaving Mexico in the early 2000s, they were discovered on the streets of Dublin. Since then, their idiosyncratic blend of rock, flamenco, metal, and cinematic influences has evolved into a global success story. From Glastonbury to the Hollywood Bowl, and from the Royal Albert Hall to the Sydney Opera House: all over the world, the duo has captivated audiences with live performances of exceptional intensity. Since the release of their debut album ‘Foc’ in 2001, they have consistently delivered impressive albums. Just think of ‘11:11’ (2009) and ‘Mettavolution’ (2019), which won a Grammy Award in 2020. With these, Rodrigo y Gabriela have definitively cemented their status as indispensable artists in the contemporary instrumental scene. With ‘Our Home,’ recorded and self-released in Tokyo.

The MEET & GREET EXPERIENCE includes:

All packages are NON-TRANSFERABLE; NO CUSTOMER NAME CHANGES will be permitted under any circumstances.

Title: Air Traffic
Description:
Ready to dive back into the soundtrack of the 2000s? Air Traffic are celebrating the 20th anniversary of their cult album ‘Fractured Life’ with a series of exclusive concerts in 2027. Nine years after their last visit to Belgium, the British indie rock band are making a grand comeback, for what promises to be a memorable reunion.

Founded in 2003 by Chris Wall, David Ryan Jordan, Tom Pritchard and Jim Maddock, Air Traffic quickly made a name for themselves on the British indie scene. After signing with EMI, the quartet released their debut album, ‘Fractured Life’, in 2007 – a collection of piano melodies, powerful vocals and catchy guitar riffs. Driven by the singles “Charlotte”, “Shooting Star” and the unmissable “No More Running Away”, the album received widespread support from national radio stations and won over a loyal following. Live, their tracks – brilliant, subtle and powerful in equal measure – reveal their full impact, and their fans turn out in force every time. Following a run of three sold-out concerts at Het Depot in 2017 and two sold-out dates at the Ancienne Belgique in 2018, the band were also invited that same year to perform at Rock Werchter.

Their anniversary tour coincides with the complete reissue of Fractured Life. For the first time, the album is available on LP vinyl in a widely distributed edition, alongside a CD version featuring tracks long requested by fans and previously unreleased tracks recorded during the same period.

Title: Gelukkig Zijn Sessie @ GC De Zeyp
Description:
This session takes place at GC De Zeyp , Zeypstraat 47, 1083 Ganshoren. Doors open at 09:30 and we’ll start singing at 10:00. The session is scheduled to finish at 11:30.

Do you want to improve your Dutch and do you enjoy singing? Then you’ve come to the right place! Every month, accompanied by two musicians and a set list full of Dutch-language classics, we head to a different community centre in Brussels. There, we practise Dutch together – through singing!

Through Dutch-language songs, you’ll get to know the language better in a fun and accessible way. At the same time, you’ll discover more about Belgian culture and meet new people. Three birds with one stone!

And don’t worry: you don’t need to be Ann Christy or Clouseau. Fun and enthusiasm are what matter most. You don’t need to be a talented singer!

We’ll provide a pianist, a lead singer, the song lyrics and a free drink. Everyone’s welcome and the sessions are free . Registration is required, though.

Take a look at our schedule and find out when we’ll be singing near you. Want to warm up your vocal cords in advance? Check out this season’s setlist here !

In collaboration with the Taalunie, Theater van A tot Z and the Flemish Community Commission (VGC) .

Title: DragonForce - Europe Tour 2027 + Visions Of Atlantis, Wings of Steel
Description:
On Sunday 18 April 2027 , British power metal band DragonForce will be performing at the Ancienne Belgique as part of their Europe Tour 2027! With a new album on the horizon, we’re in for an evening packed with lightning-fast riffs, impressive solos and top-class power metal! DragonForce will be joined for the occasion by the Austrian symphonic metal band Visions of Atlantis and the American band Wings of Steel as special guests!

DragonForce, formed in London in 1999 by guitarists Herman Li and Sam Totman, has established itself as an indispensable force within power metal, driven by dizzying solos, unrivalled technical virtuosity and compelling choruses. From ‘Valley of the Damned’ (2003) to ‘Warp Speed Warriors’ (2024), the band has created a universe in which the speed of metal blends with epic melodies and influences from the world of gaming. With ‘Inhuman Rampage’ (2006), DragonForce achieved worldwide fame. Their single “Through the Fire and Flames”, which achieved cult status thanks to the game ‘Guitar Hero III: Legends of Rock’, catapulted the band into the international spotlight and turned them into a true phenomenon, with hundreds of millions of streams to date. DragonForce are renowned for their spectacular live performances and have shared the stage with legends such as Iron Maiden, Metallica and Slipknot.

Title: Skinshape
Description: Skinshape is the musical project of British multi-instrumentalist and producer William Dorey, who was previously a member of Palace (who played at AB in ’24). His music draws inspiration from funk, soul, reggae, psychedelic rock and Brazilian music from the 1960s and 1970s. Dorey records most of his tracks himself, with a penchant for analogue instruments and vintage sounds. He has released two collaborative EPs with the Brazilian musician Pedro Mizutani, and his new album, Chapman’s Pool, was released at the end of October. As well as Skinshape, he also runs his own reggae label, Horus Records. Live, he performs his funky, danceable music with a five-piece band.

Title: Kin'gongolo Kiniata
Description:
Kin'Gongolo Kiniata’ s journey began in the bustling streets of Kinshasa. Driven by an uncompromising creative vision, the group started out playing at neighbourhood parties and local dances, quickly drawing attention with their innovative approach to Congolese musicSchooled in the effervescence of Kinshasa’s streets, Kin’Gongolo Kiniata is redefining the boundaries of Congolese music while honouring its deep cultural roots. The name "Kin'Gongolo Kiniata," which means "the crushing sound," is a perfect metaphor for the group's powerful music, created with instruments handmade from recycled materials like plastic bottles and metal. This spirit of resourcefulness reflects their ability to turn urban chaos into a unique symphony—a striking mix of Afropop, Congolese punk, and experimental electronization.

Their debut album Kiniata was loved and praised for its original sound and for the activism expressed in its lyrics and the messages they convey. Through songs that address themes such as homelessness, war and survival, Kin'Gongolo Kiniata expresses a deep need for recognition and social justice while celebrating the radical resilience of the Kinois. Their new album is expected by spring 2027 and this november a 4-track ep with bands from Columbia will appear. The exciting sound and beats reflecting reality of daily life in the capital conquered international festivals all across Europe and America.

Title: Oriana Ikomo
Description:
Based in Brussels, Oriana Ikomo (1997) is a versatile and multidisciplinary artist. She made her first appearance in November 2022, unleashing her first album 'THE LOVE I HAD' on the world. With this record, she showed not only her musical ambitions, but also an accompanying visual storytelling that reflects a cross-border ambition and style. A great example of this are the music videos of her previous tracks 'You' and 'Beautiful Sister', whose visual level is undeniably a cut above any newcomer to the scene.

Oriana's music is a unique fusion of soft yet powerful melodies, an ambient jazzy color palette and minimalist R&B beats. Her vocals, characterized by a mysterious tranquility and formidable strength, deliver poignant lyrics exploring the diverse facets of love. Oriana's impact in her home country is certainly not unseen. Her song 'IF' served as a soundtrack in the Belgian television series ‘Roomies’. In 2023, she cemented her musical and live reputation winning and making the finals in two of Belgium's biggest music competitions, Sound Track and Studio Brussels' De Nieuwe Lichting .

The question is not whether Oriana Ikomo will ever be on your radar, but when. Her distinctive sonic tapestry and compelling visual identity position her as one of the most promising talents in the vibrant Belgian music landscape.

Title: The Cinematic Orchestra
Description:
The Cinematic Orchestra’s last appearance at AB was in 2019, when they celebrated their 20th anniversary and the release of their fourth studio album.

The British band led by Jason Swinscoe continues to juggle a variety of projects. For more than two decades, the group have blended jazz, electronica, orchestral arrangement and soul into something entirely their own: expansive, intimate and instantly recognizable. From their own studio albums to film soundtracks and remixes, from concerts at prestigious venues such as the Royal Albert Hall and the Barbican Centre to collaborations with top artists such as Patrick Watson and Moses Sumney… the list is long and impressive. In April 2027 one of modern music's most influential collectives finally return with Counting Backwards , a UK and European tour with one stop in AB. Something is coming. The countdown begins"

Title: Herman van Veen
Description: After his unforgettable, packed performances to mark his 60 years on stage and 80th birthday, Herman van Veen returns to Brussels in 2027 with his new show Vandaag . A personal, moving and musical journey full of stories, songs and reflections, with the unpredictable humour and sharp wit that have characterised him for decades now. And what a journey! Thanks to what he himself describes as “luck with genes” and especially "singing" – the things that he says keep him young and active – he still performs on stage with heart and soul, giving around 140 performances per year. Herman began his career in Belgium in the 1960s. Ever since, he has called it his motherland. Kwam laatst op de markt iemand tegen die me verbaasd aankeek. ‘Bestaat u nog?’ Had de neiging me om te draaien. We raakten aan de praat. De man had mij in de jaren zestig in de schouwburg gezien. Hij was ooit geëmigreerd maar terug naar Nederland gekomen om zich te zijner tijd in Utrecht te laten begraven. Vertelde hem dat naast de genetische mazzel, het zingen er waarschijnlijk voor gezorgd heeft dat ik nog steeds met hart en ziel zo’n honderdveertig voorstellingen per jaar kan spelen. Natuurlijk kraakt het hier en daar en spring ik niet zo hoog als met achtenzeventig jaar. Dus ja meneer, ik ben er nog. En als het aan mij ligt nog langer nog. - Herman van Veen Herman van Veen (1945) is a singer, writer, composer, painter and theatre maker. He grew up in Utrecht, where he also attended the Conservatorium.

Title: Matinéeconcert: Herman van Veen
Description: The warmest bard in the Low Countries presents a new show brimming with personal, moving and musical stories, songs and reflections, delivered with unpredictable humour and sharp wit

Title: James Marriott
Description: James Marriott is back with Warning Signs, his third album and the follow-up to the UK No. 1 album Don’t Tell The Dog. The British singer-songwriter pushes the boundaries of indie pop even further, blending sharp guitars with electronic beats, massive choruses and a generous dose of pop. On singles such as ‘Burn Down The Disco’ and ‘California Rain’, he sounds at once catchy, chaotic and delightfully unpredictable. The album takes you on a journey from James’s first flutters of love and obsessive infatuation to the inevitable heartbreak that follows. So expect emotional chaos, sing-along hooks and a James Marriott who clearly still has plenty more to say.

Title: Loïc Nottet
Description: A new story begins: driven by new music and a brand-new live show, Loïc Nottet returns to unveil a new chapter of his artistic universe, freer, more intimate, and as flamboyant as ever. From France to Belgium, with Luxembourg along the way, the date is set. After three years away from the stage, Loïc Nottet is preparing for his long-awaited return. First introduced to a wide audience through the multi-certified hits Million Eyes and Mr/Mme, the Belgian artist has never stopped exploring the boundaries between pop, emotion, and performance, crafting a distinctive world where every detail matters. In Belgium, join him at Ancienne Belgique (Brussels) on April 28 and 29, 2027.

Title: PÆRISH
Description: Paerish is an alternative rock band from Paris. The band members met in film school, which influenced their musical identity. They adopted the name Paerish , based on the character Alan Parrish (Robin Williams) from the American fantasy film Jumanji . After 3 album and touring exctensively in Europe and North America the band will be releasing a brand new album called 'RITA'. According to singer/guitarist Mathias “RITA is an album deeply shaped by childhood memories, the passing of time, and the need to preserve a sense of creative sincerity through the years. Its title refers to a bell tower I could see from the window of my family’s apartment in the South of France when I was achild. Saint Rita, patron saint of lost causes, embodied something both protective andluminous to me, but also the sacrifices and uncertainty that come with having a band andtrying to make a living from it." The album explores the constant tension between nostalgia and the urgency to move forward. If you are into captivating straightforward singalong rocksongs, this is the band to check out!

Title: FIXKES
Description:
Once upon a time, there was a town. It had a tree. That tree had to go. Why? Just because. The wizard came along, with a smile and a mandate. “I’ll give the tree a second life,” he said. And hey presto, the tree became cupboards, chairs and tables, made from the finest wood the town had ever seen. Everyone was happy. Another day tomorrow.

‘Dooiebomendag’, Fixkes’ new single, is the first track from their sixth (promising) album, due for release in spring 2027.

Almost silently, Fixkes have established themselves as a force to be reckoned with. There was that massive breakthrough hit ‘Kvraagetaan’, back in 2007 (four months at number one in the charts, a record that stood for 13 years), and afterwards things went a lot quieter around the Antwerp band, but Fixkes kept at it. They kept refining their lyrics and songs, occasionally swapping the delicate for a gritty guitar solo or a touch of hip-hop. And they just got better and better.

Always with that witty, sometimes ironic take on life’s little quirks, wrapped up in what has now become a solid collection of simply good songs. Just check them out: Dardennen, Neukvriendje, Koriander van den Turk, Nooit niks, Goochelmonnetje, Ongelukkig, Buitenmens, Lievelingsdier… It must be just about the most common compliment you hear after a Fixkes gig: ‘I didn’t know you had so many good songs.’ It’s going to be a treat at the Club!

Title: uwase
Description:
uwase started making music in her bedroom. Not with the intention of releasing it, but to create a safe space for herself. When her family heard her songs, they said: “If you don’t release them, we’ll leak them ourselves.”

That’s how her debut EP, Perfect Blue, was released in 2021, followed by Pink Skies Ahead in 2022. After winning Studio Brussel’s De Nieuwe Lichting in 2025, she gained national attention for her acclaimed EP Angelo. This also earned her a MIA nomination in the ‘Breakthrough’ category in January 2026.

As both a performer and a producer, uwase shapes every aspect of her sound and artistic direction herself. Inspired by producers such as Blood Orange and artists such as Caroline Polachek, she approaches music with a keen eye for detail and atmosphere. Her influences range from contemporary voices such as Phoebe Bridgers and Lorde to the timeless energy of bands such as Phoenix and LCD Soundsystem.

She has just completed the writing, composition and production process for her debut album, due for release in early 2027. Once again, she is collaborating on the project with her co-producer Jasper Segers (Balthazar, Sylvie Kreusch, Oriana Ikomo).

uwase is returning to AB to showcase her music, but this time she’ll be performing at AB Box. Bigger and better.
